structure.unit: Crimes Against the Administration of Justice

law.catch_line: Making sound recordings of jury deliberations
law.text: If any person shall install or cause to be installed or use or cause to be used any microphone or device designed for recording or transmitting for recording sound in any jury room in this Commonwealth for the purpose of recording the deliberations of any jury or for the purpose of preparing a summary of such deliberations, he shall be guilty of a Class 6 felony.
